gov-subtitle: Provincial leaders, the Provincial Board, provincial offices, and the 22 cities and municipalities of Bukidnon
gov-sb-subtitle: The Provincial Board passes provincial ordinances and resolutions and approves the provincial budget. The Vice Governor presides. It has 10 Board Members elected by district and 4 ex officio members.
gov-dept-subtitle: Provincial Capitol Compound, Barangay 9, Malaybalay City, Bukidnon 8700. Open Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM.
gov-disaster-preparedness-emergency-resp: Disaster preparedness, emergency response, risk reduction
gov-property-assessment-tax-declarations: Property assessment, tax declarations, land records
gov-tax-payments-real-property-tax-reven: Tax payments, real property tax, revenue collection
officials-meet-the-leaders-serving-the-p: Meet the leaders serving the Province of Bukidnon
gov-governor-role: Chief executive of the Province. Leads the Provincial Governor's Office and the provincial departments.
gov-vice-governor-role: Presiding Officer of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan (Provincial Board).
gov-ex-officio-note: Ex officio seats follow the terms of their leagues and federations and can change mid-term. Confirm the current holders with the Sangguniang Panlalawigan.
gov-offices-phone-note: Phone numbers are Malaybalay landlines taken from the official directory and are still being confirmed. Offices without a listed number can be reached through the Capitol main line, (088) 813-5741.
gov-pho-desc: Public health programs, disease surveillance, and coordination with city and municipal health offices
gov-pswdo-title: Provincial Social Welfare and Development Office (PSWDO)
gov-pswdo-desc: Social welfare programs, crisis assistance, and support for vulnerable sectors
gov-pdrrmd-title: Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Department (PDRRMD)
gov-engineering-desc: Provincial roads, bridges, buildings, and other provincial infrastructure
gov-agriculture-desc: Farm extension, crop and livestock programs, and support for farmers
gov-planning-desc: Provincial development planning, investment programming, and project monitoring
gov-pictd-desc: Information and communications technology for the provincial government
gov-lgu-services-title: Handled by your city or municipality
gov-lgu-services-desc: Birth, marriage and death certificates, business permits, building permits, barangay clearances, tricycle franchises, public markets and slaughterhouses are city or municipal services. Go to the city or municipal hall where you live or do business, not the Provincial Capitol.
gov-districts-subtitle: Bukidnon has four legislative districts under Republic Act No. 10184 (2012), in effect since the 2013 elections. Each district elects one member of the House of Representatives and its own Board Members.
gov-districts-source: Population: PSA 2020 Census of Population and Housing.
gov-lgus-subtitle: Bukidnon has 2 component cities and 20 municipalities with a total of 464 barangays. Each has its own city or municipal hall for local services such as civil registration and business permits.
gov-lgus-caption: Cities and municipalities of Bukidnon with type, district, 2020 population and number of barangays
gov-lgus-source: Source: Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), 2020 Census of Population and Housing.
gov-lgus-more-stats: More figures on the statistics page
officials-sp-intro: The Vice Governor presides. The Board has 10 Board Members elected by district and 4 ex officio members.
officials-ex-officio-note: Ex officio members sit on the Board because of the league or federation they lead. These seats can change mid-term; confirm current holders with the Sangguniang Panlalawigan.
officials-house-reps-intro: Each of the four legislative districts of Bukidnon elects one member of the House of Representatives.
officials-no-data: We are still gathering this information.
